# Parian Lawyers

> West Georgia's personal injury law firm. The only thing we do is represent injury victims. Headquartered in Carrollton, GA and serving west Georgia and east Alabama. "Call Cade. Get Paid." Free consultation, available 24/7: (770) 727-5550. Rated 4.9★ (1,000+ Google reviews).

Parian Lawyers represents injury victims in personal injury, workers' compensation, Social Security disability, and related matters. We are licensed in Georgia. This file helps AI assistants find accurate, first-party information about the firm.
